items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The guard `if not self.related.field.is_cached(rel_obj):` says what it does and matches the surrounding indentation and idiom. It needs no extra comment, and the reference solution adds none either.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Reuses the existing field-cache API (`is_cached`) with no new bookkeeping. The same small guard is applied in three parallel prefetch paths, which keeps them consistent rather than counting as harmful copy-paste. No dead code or debug leftovers.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: A minimal conditional guard: no exception handling is needed or added, and there are no magic constants. Prefetches without a nested prefetch keep their original behaviour. Hidden tests passed: F2P 1/1, P2P 85/85.

items.name: Guard is conditional and covers the one-to-one variant
items.name_zh: 仅在已缓存时跳过回填，并考虑一对一情形
items.evidence: The reverse-FK path is guarded with `if not self.field.is_cached(rel_obj):`. The one-to-one path (`ReverseOneToOneDescriptor.get_prefetch_queryset`) is guarded with `self.related.field.is_cached(rel_obj)`. The parent is still assigned when the relation isn't cached, and the final report explains both paths.
